batch.title: Fix wrong MCP URL in cowork workspace and cron files

Simple string replace across cowork-workspace-team-claude-desktop/*.md + .claude/commands/crons/ + cowork-refactory-expert/main.md.

notes: Root cause of 1937a identified from user-supplied MCP URL context. zenmidi.com/mcp returns 404 — cloudflared has no route for /mcp, only /vn-market/mcp and /vn-market/sse. 15 files use wrong URL. Correct URL confirmed: https://zenmidi.com/vn-market/mcp (cron-news-scout.md + cron-unified-agent.md use this correctly and work). FIX skips planning — direct to execute.
